title: Specs Styles Schema
description: JSON Schema for style properties emitted by the Specs Figma plugin

Styles.description: Collection of style properties emitted by Styles.data(). Each property value depends on its type and config.format.tokens setting. Applicable properties vary by element type.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation about the element's centre, in degrees.

opacity.description: How opaque the element and its contents are, from fully transparent to fully opaque.

locked.description: Whether the element is protected from selection and editing on the canvas.

backgroundColor.description: The fill painted behind an element's contents.

backgroundImage.description: An image painted as a layer's fill, used where the library has no image component to bind instead.

fillColor.description: The fill of a glyph or vector shape.

textColor.description: The fill of a text element's glyphs.

effects.description: Shadows and blurs applied to the element.

clipsContent.description: Whether content extending past the element's bounds is cut off at them.

cornerRadius.description: How much each corner is rounded.

width.description: The element's width in pixels when horizontal sizing is FIXED.

height.description: The element's height in pixels when vertical sizing is FIXED.

minWidth.description: The smallest width the element may take when its width is otherwise flexible.

minHeight.description: The smallest height the element may take when its height is otherwise flexible.

maxWidth.description: The largest width the element may take when its width is otherwise flexible.

maxHeight.description: The largest height the element may take when its height is otherwise flexible.

position.description: Whether the element is placed by its parent's layout or by its own offsets. Present whenever any positioning offset is.

top.description: Distance from the parent's top edge, when the element is positioned against it.

bottom.description: Distance from the parent's bottom edge, when the element is positioned against it.

start.description: Distance from the parent's inline-start edge, when the element is positioned against it.

end.description: Distance from the parent's inline-end edge, when the element is positioned against it.

centerHorizontalOffset.description: Horizontal distance from the parent's centre, when the element is centred on that axis.

centerVerticalOffset.description: Vertical distance from the parent's centre, when the element is centred on that axis.

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: What determines the element's width — a fixed value, its contents, or the space its parent offers.

layoutSizingVertical.description: What determines the element's height — a fixed value, its contents, or the space its parent offers.

strokes.description: The colour of the element's stroke.

strokeAlign.description: Where the stroke sits relative to the element's boundary.

strokeDashPattern.description: The dash and gap lengths that make a stroke dashed rather than solid.

typography.description: The type treatment of a text element — family, size, spacing and case.

textAlignHorizontal.description: Where text sits on the inline axis, named by logical direction rather than by left and right.

textAlignVertical.description: Where text sits within the height available to it.

textOverflow.description: What happens to text that does not fit the space available to it.

maxLines.description: The most lines the text may occupy before it is truncated, usually declared with `textOverflow`.

mainAxisAlignment.description: Where children sit along the axis their parent stacks them on.

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Whether the stacking axis sizes to its contents or to a fixed value.

crossAxisAlignment.description: Where children sit across the axis their parent stacks them on.

layoutMode.description: Whether the element stacks its children, and along which axis.

wrap.description: Whether children that overflow the stacking axis continue onto another line.

wrapAlignment.description: How wrapped lines are distributed across the axis they stack on, when the element wraps.

itemReverseZIndex.description: Whether later children paint behind earlier ones rather than in front.

itemSpacing.description: The gap held between stacked children.

padding.description: The space held between the element's bounds and its contents.

cornerSmoothing.description: How far a rounded corner departs from a circular arc toward a squircle.

aspectRatio.description: The ratio the element's width and height are locked to.

TextContentStyles.description: The formatting a text primitive takes on when it fills a slot. Deliberately narrower than Styles: only properties that format text appear, so a container's layout or surface styling cannot enter the content record. Each property is typed identically to its Styles counterpart, so a value valid in styles is valid here. typography carries the composite, so its own members travel inside it. (ADR-102)

textColor.description: Text fill color of the content.

typography.description: Typography of the content. TokenReference when a named text style is referenced; Typography when defined inline.

textAlignHorizontal.description: Horizontal text alignment using logical inline-axis directions — START, CENTER, END, or JUSTIFY. Structural property — not token-bindable.

textAlignVertical.description: Vertical text alignment of the content.

textOverflow.description: How overflowing content is handled — CLIP or ELLIPSIS. Structural property — not token-bindable.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines before ELLIPSIS overflow applies; null or absent means no limit.

GlyphContentStyles.description: The formatting a glyph primitive takes on when it fills a slot. fillColor plus the two dimensions: a glyph is sized rather than laid out — its box is the icon's own, set on the layer and not derived from the slot's layout the way a text run's measure is — so a glyph fill that does not carry its dimensions loses them, with nothing for a render to restore. That is why width and height belong to the fill here even though no text member does. (ADR-102)

width.description: Width of the glyph box, in pixels.

height.description: Height of the glyph box, in pixels.

ContentStyles.description: The styles applied to primitive content filling an element, as distinct from Styles, which are the element's own. Keyed by primitive, using the same reserved markers SlotProp.anyOf carries, because a slot's default content may hold more than one kind — a glyph and a label — and each kind is formatted by a disjoint property set. On a slot element each entry is captured from the first top-level primitive of that kind in the slot's default content, per variant, and is overridden per variant through variants[].elements exactly as styles is. A component fill is formatted by the component it instantiates, so a consumer rendering one applies styles and discards contentStyles. Meaningful only on a slot element, and its keys should agree with that slot's anyOf markers — both authoring/generator contracts, neither schema-enforced. (ADR-102)

$text.description: Formatting for a text primitive filling this slot.

$glyph.description: Formatting for a glyph primitive filling this slot.

AspectRatioValue.description: Aspect ratio expressed as a numerator/denominator pair. `x` is the numerator, `y` is the denominator (e.g. x:16, y:9 for 16:9).

AspectRatioStyleValue.description: Aspect ratio value. Object pair when the node has a locked ratio; null when no constraint is active. TokenReference is intentionally excluded — aspect ratio is a structural lock of literal numbers in the Figma API.

NumberStyleValue.description: Pure number style value (from NumberStyle processor)

BooleanBindableStyleValue.description: Boolean style value that can be bound to props or conditional expressions (visible only)

GradientCenter.description: Normalised 2-D centre point used by RADIAL and ANGULAR gradient variants. Both axes are in the range 0–1 relative to the fill bounding box.

GradientStop.description: A single stop in a gradient definition.

position.description: Stop position along the gradient vector, normalised 0–1

oneOf.description: Formatted color string when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT
Stop color as a DTCG Color object
Stop color as a token reference

LinearGradient.description: A linear gradient defined by an angle and two or more colour stops. Maps to linear-gradient() (CSS) or LinearGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

angle.description: Angle of the gradient line, in degrees

RadialGradient.description: A radial gradient defined by a centre point and two or more colour stops. Maps to radial-gradient() (CSS) or RadialGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

center.description: Normalised centre point of the gradient ellipse

AngularGradient.description: An angular (conic) gradient defined by a centre point and two or more colour stops. Maps to conic-gradient() (CSS) or AngularGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

center.description: Normalised centre point of the gradient sweep

GradientValue.description: A discriminated union of the three supported cross-platform gradient types (LINEAR, RADIAL, ANGULAR). The `type` field is the discriminant. DIAMOND is intentionally excluded.

ColorObject.description: Inline resolved color value per DTCG Color Module §4.1. `colorSpace` and `components` are required; `alpha` defaults to 1 (fully opaque) when omitted; `hex` is an optional 6-digit sRGB fallback (#RRGGBB — no alpha channel in hex). Consumers SHOULD prefer `colorSpace` + `components` for rendering.

colorSpace.description: Color space identifier per DTCG Color §4.2 (e.g. 'srgb', 'oklch', 'display-p3').

oneOf.title: sRGB
oneOf.description: The standard web colour space. Three components, red, green and blue.

oneOf.title: Linear sRGB
oneOf.description: sRGB without its transfer function, so component values are proportional to light intensity.

oneOf.title: HSL
oneOf.description: sRGB addressed as hue, saturation and lightness.

oneOf.title: HWB
oneOf.description: sRGB addressed as hue, whiteness and blackness.

oneOf.title: CIELAB
oneOf.description: Perceptually uniform, with a D50 white point. Lightness plus two opponent axes.

oneOf.title: CIELCh
oneOf.description: CIELAB addressed as lightness, chroma and hue.

oneOf.title: Oklab
oneOf.description: Perceptually uniform with improved hue linearity over CIELAB. Lightness plus two opponent axes.

oneOf.title: Oklch
oneOf.description: Oklab addressed as lightness, chroma and hue.

oneOf.title: Display P3
oneOf.description: A wide-gamut RGB space covering more saturated colour than sRGB.

oneOf.title: Adobe RGB (1998)
oneOf.description: A wide-gamut RGB space widely used in print workflows.

oneOf.title: ProPhoto RGB
oneOf.description: A very wide-gamut RGB space used in photographic editing.

oneOf.title: Rec. 2020
oneOf.description: The ultra-high-definition broadcast RGB space.

oneOf.title: CIE XYZ (D65)
oneOf.description: Device-independent tristimulus values with a D65 white point.

oneOf.title: CIE XYZ (D50)
oneOf.description: Device-independent tristimulus values with a D50 white point.

components.description: Ordered component values (number or 'none' keyword) for the given colorSpace. The number of components and their ranges depend on the colorSpace per DTCG Color §4.2.

alpha.description: Alpha channel 0–1. Defaults to 1 (fully opaque) when omitted.

hex.description: Optional 6-digit sRGB fallback (#RRGGBB). Alpha is excluded per DTCG Color §4.1. Consumers SHOULD prefer colorSpace + components for rendering.

ColorStyleValue.description: Color style value. Covers formatted color string, inline resolved color object, token reference, inline gradient, or null. The string arm is emitted when Config.format.color is set to a non-OBJECT format.

oneOf.description: Formatted color string (e.g. '#FF6600', 'rgba(255,102,0,1)') emitted when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT.
Inline resolved color value with colorSpace, components, optional alpha, and optional 6-digit hex fallback.

ObjectFitValue.description: How the image is fitted to its layer (CSS object-fit vocabulary). Structural property — not token-bindable. Absent means COVER. Transformer remaps Figma FILL->COVER, FIT->CONTAIN, and lossily coerces CROP->COVER, TILE->COVER so no image fill is dropped.

oneOf.description: The image fills the layer, cropping whichever axis overflows.
The whole image is visible within the layer, leaving space on whichever axis is shorter.

ImageValue.description: An image fill value — a reference into an images registry plus optional fit.

$image.description: Pointer into an images registry, e.g. '#/images/hero' (single-file) or 'card.examples#/images/hero' (concern-split).

ImageStyleValue.description: Container image fill value — an ImageValue object, a TokenReference (when the fill comes from an applied Figma fill style whose paint is an image), or null. Fallback representation used when no image component is configured.

StringStyleValue.description: Pure string style value (from StringStyle processor)

MixedNumberStyleValue.description: Numeric style that can have 'mixed' value (from MixedStyle processor)

MixedStringStyleValue.description: String style that can have 'mixed' value (from MixedStyle processor)

Sides.description: Per-side values using logical inline-axis directions (start/end). Used for padding and strokeWeight when sides differ.

end.description: Inline-end value (right in LTR, left in RTL)

start.description: Inline-start value (left in LTR, right in RTL)

Corners.description: Per-corner values using logical inline-axis directions (topStart/topEnd/bottomStart/bottomEnd). Used for cornerRadius when corners differ.

topStart.description: Top-start corner (top-left in LTR, top-right in RTL)

topEnd.description: Top-end corner (top-right in LTR, top-left in RTL)

bottomEnd.description: Bottom-end corner (bottom-right in LTR, bottom-left in RTL)

bottomStart.description: Bottom-start corner (bottom-left in LTR, bottom-right in RTL)

SidesStyleValue.description: Sides style value. Scalar number when uniform; Sides object when per-side values differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

CornersStyleValue.description: Corners style value. Scalar number when uniform; Corners object when per-corner values differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

ItemSpacing.description: Bi-axial item spacing values using absolute visual axes. Used for itemSpacing when horizontal and vertical gaps differ.

ItemSpacingStyleValue.description: Item spacing value. Scalar number when uniform; ItemSpacing object when horizontal and vertical gaps differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

StrokeDashPattern.description: Dash geometry for a dashed stroke. dash and gap are in pixels and correspond to index 0 and 1 of Figma's strokeDashes array.

StrokeDashPatternStyleValue.description: Dash pattern for a stroke. Present (non-null) when the stroke is dashed; null or absent when solid. Structural property — not token-bindable.

LayoutModeStyleValue.description: Layout mode value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: No auto-layout. Children are placed by their own coordinates rather than stacked.

oneOf.title: Row
oneOf.description: Children stack along the inline axis.

oneOf.title: Column
oneOf.description: Children stack along the block axis.

oneOf.title: Not specified
oneOf.description: No layout mode is recorded for this element.

WrapAlignmentStyleValue.description: Wrap alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Wrapped lines gather at the leading edge, leaving any remaining space after the last line.
Remaining space is distributed between wrapped lines.

oneOf.title: Not applicable
oneOf.description: The element does not wrap, so there are no wrapped lines to distribute.

MainAxisAlignmentStyleValue.description: Main axis alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Children gather at the leading edge of the stacking axis.
Children gather at the trailing edge of the stacking axis.
Children gather at the midpoint of the stacking axis.
Remaining space is distributed between children, pinning the first and last to the edges.

oneOf.title: Not applicable
oneOf.description: The element has no auto-layout, so there is no stacking axis to align along.

CrossAxisAlignmentStyleValue.description: Cross axis alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Children align to the leading edge of the axis across the stack.
Children align to the trailing edge of the axis across the stack.
Children align to the midpoint of the axis across the stack.
Children fill the axis across the stack rather than sizing to their own content.
Children align on the baseline of their first line of text.

oneOf.title: Not applicable
oneOf.description: The element has no auto-layout, so there is no cross axis to align on.

TextAlignHorizontalStyleValue.description: Horizontal text alignment value using logical inline-axis directions. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Text aligns to the inline-start edge — the left in a left-to-right script.
Text centres on the inline axis.
Text aligns to the inline-end edge — the right in a left-to-right script.
Word spacing stretches so every line but the last meets both edges.

oneOf.title: Not specified
oneOf.description: No horizontal alignment is recorded for this element.

TextOverflowStyleValue.description: Text overflow handling value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Text is cut at the boundary with no indication that it continues.
Text is cut at the boundary and a trailing ellipsis marks the truncation.

oneOf.title: Not specified
oneOf.description: No overflow behaviour is recorded for this element.

PositionStyleValue.description: Position value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: The parent's auto-layout places the element, and no positioning offsets are recorded.
The element is placed against its parent's bounds by the offset keys.

oneOf.title: Not positioned
oneOf.description: The element has no parent bounds to be positioned within, as on a document root.

PositionOffset.description: Positional offset value. Pixel number, percentage string (SCALE constraint), or null. Not token-bindable.

oneOf.description: Font weight numeric value
Percentage (e.g., '150%') or 'auto'
Pixel value

StyleIdValue.description: Style ID reference (textStyleId; removed from Styles in v0.11.0 — retained for historical reference only)

oneOf.description: Style ID string

Shadow.description: A single evaluated shadow. inset distinguishes drop (absent/false) from inner (true). Field names align with the DTCG Format Module shadow token.

inset.description: true for inner shadow; absent or false for drop shadow (DTCG)

oneOf.description: Formatted color string when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT
DTCG Color object

Blur.description: A single evaluated blur effect. Singular per type; the containing key (layerBlur vs backgroundBlur) determines render role.

Effects.description: Inline effects grouped by role. Each key is optional; a key is omitted when no effects of that type are present on the node.

shadows.description: Ordered list of shadows; Shadow.inset distinguishes drop (absent/false) vs inner (true)

layerBlur.description: Layer blur (filter effect on the node itself)

EffectsStyleValue.description: Effect value. TokenReference when the node references a named effects style; Effects when effects are defined inline.

oneOf.description: Named effects style reference ($type: "effects")
Inline effects grouped by role

PropBinding.description: A component-prop binding. Emitted when a property is bound to a Figma component property. Discriminated by $binding to avoid JSON Schema $ref keyword collision.

$binding.description: JSON Pointer to the bound prop within this spec's props block, e.g. '#/props/propName'

ConditionArgs.description: Arguments for a condition expression. value is the prop binding to test; compareTo is the operand for binary operations.

value.description: The prop binding whose value is tested

compareTo.description: Comparison operand for binary operations (equals, notEquals). Omitted for unary operations.

ConditionExpression.description: A declarative condition expression pairing an operation with its arguments.

Conditional.description: A conditional binding. Evaluates the condition against a bound prop and resolves to the then or else branch.

ReferenceValue.description: @deprecated Removed in v1.0.0. Use PropBinding ($binding key) instead.

TokenReference.description: Platform-neutral token reference. $token and $type are the complete platform-facing API surface; $extensions["com.figma"] carries Figma extraction provenance only and is not required by platform consumers.

$token.description: Token path, separated by '/', mirroring the path of the Figma variable or style it names — e.g. 'Color/On surface variant'. Segments may contain spaces and punctuation, so the path is not constrained by a pattern.

$type.description: DTCG token type (Format Module §9). 'effects' is a Specs extension for EffectsGroup references (multi-shadow + blur composite) with no DTCG equivalent. 'image' is a Specs extension for fill-style references whose styled paint is an image (ADR-063), likewise without a DTCG equivalent.

oneOf.description: Resolves to a colour.
Resolves to a length — a radius, a spacing step, a stroke weight.
Resolves to text, such as a font family name.
Resolves to a unitless number, such as an opacity or a line-height multiplier.
Resolves to true or false.
Resolves to a single shadow.
Resolves to a gradient.
Resolves to a composite of type properties — family, size, line height and the rest.

oneOf.title: Effects (Specs extension)
oneOf.description: Resolves to a group of effects — multiple shadows plus blur — which DTCG has no type for.

oneOf.title: Image (Specs extension)
oneOf.description: Resolves to a fill style whose paint is an image, which DTCG has no type for.

$extensions.description: Tool-specific metadata per DTCG §5.2.3 (reverse domain name notation). Not required for platform code generation.

collectionName.description: Figma collection name, e.g. 'DS Color' (variables only)

rawValue.description: Value resolved by Figma at extraction time. Color tokens resolve to a DTCG Color object. No DTCG equivalent; Figma extraction provenance only.

VariableStyle.description: @deprecated Removed in v1.0.0. Use TokenReference instead.

Typography.description: Inline typography properties grouped into a composite object. All fields are optional; only properties set on the text node are present.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels; 'mixed' allowed (mixableNumber primitive)

fontFamily.description: Font family name, 'mixed' when varied, or token reference for variable-bound fonts

fontStyle.description: Style name (e.g., 'Bold'), 'mixed' when varied, or token reference for variable-bound fonts

oneOf.description: Percentage (e.g., '150%') or 'auto'
Pixel value

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing in pixels; 'mixed' allowed (mixableNumber primitive)

paragraphSpacing.description: Spacing between paragraphs in pixels (pureNumber primitive)

leadingTrim.description: Leading trim mode — 'NONE' or 'CAP_HEIGHT' per Figma API; 'mixed' when varied across selection

oneOf.description: The line box keeps the font's full leading above and below the text.
Leading above the cap height and below the baseline is trimmed from the line box.
The value varies across the text this style was read from, so no single value applies.

listSpacing.description: Spacing for list items in pixels (pureNumber primitive)

hangingPunctuation.description: Whether hanging punctuation is enabled (boolean primitive)

hangingList.description: Whether hanging list is enabled (boolean primitive)

TypographyStyleValue.description: Typography value. TokenReference when the text node references a named text style; Typography when typography is defined inline.

oneOf.description: Named text style reference ($type: "typography")
Inline typography properties
